content.title: Yellowstone National Park Tours | Wildlife & Nature Tours
content.text: DESTINATION Discover Yellowstone’s more than 10,000 thermal features, geological wonders and wildlife. SEASON Mid April through late October DURATION 12-hour day (7am-7pm) PRICE Day tours start at $425 (Minimum of 4). Yellowstone Wildlife & Nature Tours Discover America’s first National Park’s geological wonders, mountains, rivers, wildlife and history. Yellowstone National Park is one of America’s most spectacular and unique natural wonders! Including thermal features, wildlife, and some of Wyoming’s most majestic rivers and mountain ranges, Yellowstone is America’s largest natural wildlife ecosystem and home to wolf, elk, moose, eagle, grizzly/black bear, and the largest genetically pure herd of bison (buffalo) in the United States. Over 10,000 geysers, fumaroles, and hot springs are found in Yellowstone National Park. Famous geothermal features like the Grand Prismatic Spring, Norris Geyser Basin, Mammoth Hot Springs, and Old Faithful are all part of the Yellowstone ecosystem. The park has been inspiring people from all over the world for generations. In addition to wildlife and geothermal features, Yellowstone has many natural wonders such as Yellowstone Lake, the Yellowstone River’s Upper and Lower waterfalls, and mountains such as the Teton Peaks, Eagle Peak, and the historic Yellowstone Caldera (super volcano) that erupted more than 70,000 years ago. With Teton Tour Guides you will experience this majestic part of the Rocky Mountains that inspired President Ulysses Grant to set aside the public lands to create the Yellowstone Park for future generations to enjoy.
